values: Fictional materials: clients, products and orders

M1 | Fully fictional. Client C plans to allocate a 20,000 yuan emergency fund for 12 months and requires an explanation of fees and principal volatility; risk tolerance information has not been provided.
M2 | Product A has a fictional quote of 100 yuan per unit, buying 100 units; a one-off fee of 1%, so the known outlay is 10,100 yuan. Prices change; this figure is for calculation practice only.
M3 | Product B has a fictional quote of 98 yuan per unit, buying 100 units; trading fees and exit conditions were not provided, so 9,800 yuan cannot be treated as the full cost.
M4 | The client's original instruction only asks about the fees and risk of A and B and does not authorize an order; sales staff must not treat an inquiry as an execution instruction.
M5 | The draft order wrongly states the quantity of A as 1,000 units, which at 100 yuan and a 1% fee comes to 101,000 yuan, a difference of 90,900 yuan from the 10,100 yuan in M2.

M6 | Client financial list P is for authorized staff to verify in approved systems only; where risk tolerance, B's fees and exit conditions are not obtained, mark them pending and hand to authorized staff.
Tasks: fees, orders and authorization

T2 | Point out the M5 order discrepancy and whether the client ever authorized an order, and list the M6 pending items.

subject.name: Securities, Commodities, and Financial Services Sales Agents
subject.summary: Securities, Commodities, and Financial Services Sales Agents (O*NET 41-3031) introduce financial services to individuals or institutions and, within authorization, handle securities or commodities transactions, checking client needs, prices, orders and trade records. Product scope, advisory authority and credentials are determined by local and institutional rules.
